title: FIXED Krystal Dance V3
features:
This project is a fix and fork of Krystal Dance V3, which was originally created by Hemi. The original license of the project has been fully maintained, and all credit for the original work goes to Hemi. This version only introduces bug fixes, adjustments, and improvements while preserving the original features and spirit of the project.

The dances may look off.
